title: 前瞻性记忆检索：零推理承诺链接机制
summary: 提出一种零查询推理的前瞻性记忆检索项：将用户承诺存入显式账本，触发条目关联的记忆获得显著性加成，与嵌入检索乘法融合。在合成任务集上，困难层 recall@5 从 0.000 提升至 0.955，且无误触发。
summary_en: Introduces a zero-inference prospective term for personal memory retrieval: commitments are held in an explicit ledger, and memory items linked to a firing entry receive a salience boost blended multiplicatively into embedding retrieval. On a synthetic task set, recall@5 on the hard stratum rose from 0.000 to 0.955 with zero false boosts.
